active.label: Use: Plant Tree
active.desc: Targets the ground to plant a happy little tree that lasts for 20 seconds.

alchemist.desc:
Alchemist melts down Aghanim's Scepter to grant an allied hero all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. Alchemist will gain bonus 15 damage and 3 additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.

BASE BONUS GOLD: 2
MAX BONUS GOLD PER KILL: 16

axe.desc:
Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.

DEBUFF DURATION: 6
ATTACK DAMAGE REDUCTION: 12%
MAX STACKS: 5

bristleback.desc: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after 0.5s, forcefully ejects 5 sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every 0.4s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by 40%.

centaur_warrunner.desc:
Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.

TOTAL DURATION: 6

chaos_knight.desc: Gains a passive component. When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a 50% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control. When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.

rattletrap.desc:
Supercharges Clockwerk's abilities:
Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.
Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.
Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fires additional rockets to either side of the target.
Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.
Jetpack: Moves faster.
Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.

DURATION: 18
SELF SLOW DURATION: 3
BONUS ARMOR NEAR COGS: 25%
BATTERY ASSAULT RADIUS: 330
COGS RADIUS: 330
HOOKSHOT RADIUS BONUS: 50%
HOOKSHOT DURATION BONUS: 50%
BONUS ROCKET FLARES: 2
ROCKET FLARE DURATION BONUS: 35%
ROCKET FLARE DAMAGE BONUS: 35%
JETPACK SPEED: 40%

dawnbreaker.desc: Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.
Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for 2s after landing.

doom_bringer.desc: Doom applies Break to enemies. Allies in a 350 radius around the doomed target also suffer the effects of Doom. Allows Doom to be self-cast to affect enemies around himself with Doom.

dragon_knight.desc: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.

earth_spirit.desc:
Earth Spirit temporarily enchants a hero, granting them the properties of a Stone Remnant. After a short duration the remnant shatters, releasing the hero and damaging nearby enemies. Can be cast on Stone Remnants with a 5s cooldown. Has a larger cast range when cast on an ally hero.

REMNANT DURATION: 2.4
SHATTER DAMAGE: 450
SHATTER RADIUS: 450
CAST RANGE ON ALLIES: 500

earthshaker.desc:
Enchant Totem becomes a ground target ability, causing Earthshaker to jump in the air and land at the target spot, casting Enchant Totem there. Self-casting the ability will behave in the original form, without jumping. Grants Enchant Totem a cleaving attack.

JUMP DISTANCE: 950
CLEAVE DAMAGE: 40%
CLEAVE DISTANCE: 650

elder_titan.desc: Causes Elder Titan to become debuff immune and gain 50% magic resistance for 2 seconds per affected enemy hero when the spirit returns.

kunkka.desc: Ghostship creates a fleet of 2 ships at the target point on a 2.5 second interval. Each ship now also fires 3 waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal 40% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.

largo.desc: Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time.

Deals additional 6/10/14 magic damage per Groovin' stack when this song is used in double-strumming.

DAMAGE PER STACK: 6/10/14

muerta.desc:
Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.

DAMAGE: 225/300/375/450

sven.desc: Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional 180 damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.

huskar.desc:
Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.

TAUNT DURATION: 3
CAST RANGE BONUS: 250

juggernaut.desc:
Performs a short Omnislash for 1 seconds.

DURATION: 1

lifestealer.desc:
Increases cast range and reduces cooldown to 20s. Infest may target enemy heroes for a short duration, attacking them from the inside while increasing Lifestealer's regeneration rate.

SELF MAX HP REGEN: 6%/8%/10%
ENEMY DURATION: 4
ATTACK RATE: 1

omniknight.desc:
Guardian Angel has global radius, affects buildings, and amplifies health restoration.

BONUS HEALTH RESTORATION: 50%

antimage.desc:
Increases Max Mana Burned per Hit.

MAX MANA BURNED PER HIT: 3.3%/4.2%/5.1%/6%

After casting Blink, your next Mana Break within 5s burns an additional 20% max mana and prevents the target from regenerating or gaining mana for a short duration. This debuff is undispellable.

DEBUFF DURATION: 6

sniper.desc:
Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.

STUN DURATION: 0.8/1/1.2
AIM DURATION: 0.5

slardar.desc:
Provides additional HP Regen, Armor and Status Resistance while in a puddle, trail, or river. Increases puddle/trail radius by 75% and puddle/trail duration by 5s.

HP REGEN: 22
BONUS ARMOR: 10
STATUS RESISTANCE: 40%

legion_commander.desc:
Increases movement speed and becomes a 500 area of effect ability, and always affects Legion Commander when used.

BONUS MOVE SPEED: 25% / 28% / 31% / 34%
When Legion Commander wins a duel, Press the Attack is automatically triggered around her.

lycan.desc: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain 40% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within 1200 range of each other.

mars.desc:
Lowers cooldown by 10s and increases duration. If an enemy is killed in the Arena, Mars and all of his allies inside the Arena restore 35% of their max health and mana and get a 35% attack damage buff for 20s. This effect stacks.

DURATION: 6.5

night_stalker.desc:
Increases bonus movement speed by 15% and attack speed by 50. Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.

MOVE SPEED: 39%
ATTACK SPEED: 90

ogre_magi.desc: Fireblast is refined, reducing cooldown by 1s and increasing cast speed by 25%.

Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing 150 + 1.5x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is 35% of Ogre Magi's current mana.

STUN DURATION: 1.2

phoenix.desc:
Increases number of attacks to destroy Supernova and allows Phoenix to cast Supernova on an allied hero, bringing both into the sun to be reborn together.

ATTACKS TO DESTROY: 7/10/13
CAST RANGE: 500

primal_beast.desc:
When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases 3 waves of 2 projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.

DAMAGE: 85
SPLIT DELAY: 1.25
BREAK DURATION: 2.5

pudge.desc:
Increases Rot radius by 200, damage by 90, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by 20%.

RADIUS: 450
DAMAGE: 120/150/180/210
HEALTH RESTORATION LOSS: 20%

spirit_breaker.desc:
Increases knockback. If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive 20% damage), and the original target takes 25% of Greater Bash's damage again.

KNOCKBACK DISTANCE: 193/202/208/212

tidehunter.desc:
Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line. Decreases cooldown.

RADIUS: 260
COOLDOWN: 7
RANGE: 2200

timbersaw.desc: Reactive Armor can now be activated to get max stacks and 150 damage barrier. Grants Timbersaw 100 + 75 barrier amount per second for each enemy hero within 450 radius of Timbersaw up to a maximum of 800. After 8 seconds, Timbersaw deals damage to every hero within 450 radius equal to 200 + his remaining barrier amount and loses all of his barrier.

tiny.desc:
CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.

TARGET RADIUS: 400
TREE GRAB RADIUS: 700
THROW INTERVAL: 0.5
MAX CHANNEL TIME: 2.5

treant_protector.desc: Decreases Cooldown to 85/75/65 seconds. When casting Overgrowth, Treant Protector draws power from the soil, greatly increasing his size for 16 seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of 345, 100% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals 60% of his attack damage in a 300 unit radius.

tusk.desc:
Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within 250 radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by 50% if kicking a creep.

KICK PUSH DISTANCE: 1200
MOVE SLOW: 40%
SLOW DURATION: 2
DAMAGE: 550

underlord.desc:
Summons a Pit of Malice around each of the portals. Reduces cooldown.

COOLDOWN: 90/85/80

wraith_king.desc:
Turns Vampiric Spirit into an aura, allowing allied heroes to turn into wraiths when slain. Extends wraith duration.

WRAITH DURATION: 5.25
AURA RADIUS: 1200

bloodseeker.desc:
Increases initial damage and grants 2 Rupture Charges.

HEALTH DAMAGE: 15%

bounty_hunter.desc:
Increases cast range and applies Jinada on hit.

CAST RANGE: 600

broodmother.desc:
Broodmother may create up to 5 invisible web lines touching any existing web. Enemy Heroes that cross the web line will spring the trap, becoming rooted, revealed in fog, and take damage over time. Multiple Heroes can trip on the same line until it's destroyed after being initially triggered. Broodmother's team is alerted via the minimap when an enemy has triggered the snare.

MAX CHARGES: 2
BASE CHARGE RESTORE TIME: 30
FORMATION DELAY: 2
ROOT DURATION: 3
DAMAGE PER SECOND: 100
WEB LINE WIDTH: 900

clinkz.desc:
Summons a row of Burning Skeleton Archers in the target location.

RANGE: 900
COUNT: 6
SPAWN INTERVAL: 0.1

drow_ranger.desc:
Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.

HEALTH RESTORATION LOSS PER STACK: 10%
BONUS DAMAGE PER STACK: 18
STACK DURATION: 7
BURST RADIUS: 650
BURST DAMAGE PER STACK: 60
BURST MOVEMENT SLOW: 40%
BURST SLOW DURATION: 2
MAX STACKS: 9

ember_spirit.desc:
Increases cast range, initial remnant speed, and maximum charges.

RANGE: 3000
SPEED MULTIPLIER: 2
MAX CHARGES: 5

faceless_void.desc:
Applies a Time Lock to all units at the landing destination.

TIME LOCK RADIUS: 325
Available for 1.5 seconds after landing Time Walk. If used in this period, you will reverse your time walk back to your previous cast location. Does not affect health or proc scepter hits.

gyrocopter.desc: Gyrocopter gains a Side Gunner that attacks enemy units in a 700 unit radius every 1.3s with his attack. Prioritizes furthest unit away within its range.

hoodwink.desc:
Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.

BUSHWHACK RADIUS: 250
ILLUSION DURATION: 6
BUSHWHACK DURATION: 1.6
MOVEMENT SPEED: 15%
SHARPSHOOTER DAMAGE: 60%

Increases arrow speed and movement speed slow.

ARROW SPEED: 2750
MOVE SLOW: 50%/60%/70%

kez.desc: Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within 3 seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown. Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.

lone_druid.desc:
Entangle applies 5 stacks to enemy heroes in the area and has increased radius. Enemies no longer have protection from gaining stacks while Entangled.

RADIUS: 450

luna.desc:
Allows Luna to cast Eclipse on an allied unit or herself and have its effects follow them, or cast it on an area. Increases total beams, reduces duration, removes the limit on beams per unit, and makes the beams appear twice as fast.

TOTAL BEAMS: 6/12/18
MAX BEAMS PER UNIT: 6/12/18
ECLIPSE DURATION: 1.8/3.6/5.4

medusa.desc:
Allows on-hit effects to apply to the secondary attacks from Split Shot. Increases arrow count.

EXTRA TARGETS: 5

meepo.desc:
Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a 600 radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains 40% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them. When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals 50% more damage for each Meepo on top.

DURATION: 20

In MegaMeepo form, Meepo flings the topmost meepo towards a target within a 900 range, dealing damage and slowing their movement speed.

DAMAGE: 225
MOVEMENT SLOW: 60%

mirana.desc:
Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.

SEARCH RADIUS: 500
PRIMARY HIT STARSTORM DAMAGE: 80%

monkey_king.desc:
Spawns a monkey soldier near Monkey King at regular intervals. Soldiers do not spawn while invisible or on trees. Soldiers only attack buildings when Monkey King himself is nearby. Soldiers can now gain Jingu Mastery charges independently.

SOLDIER SPAWN INTERVAL: 4
SOLDIER DURATION: 15

morphling.desc:
Adds an alt-cast to Morph. When enabled, a strong illusion is created of the target hero that can cast all of the hero's basic abilities. If the illusion is alive when Morphling toggles the ability, he will take the place of the illusion, destroying it.

ILLUSION OUTGOING DAMAGE: 100%
ILLUSION INCOMING DAMAGE: 200%

naga_siren.desc: Increases cast range and projectile speed. Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.
Allows Reel In to affect Spell Immune units.

phantom_assassin.desc:
Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.

MAX HEALTH DAMAGE: 30%
BREAK DURATION: 4
RADIUS: 550

phantom_lancer.desc:
Increases Range. Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them. Additionally, every 600 units rushed creates a Juxtapose illusion that rushes to the target alongside Phantom Lancer.

MAX RUSH DISTANCE: 1175/1250/1325/1400
COLLISION RADIUS: 125

razor.desc: Causes Eye of the Storm to strike two different units instead of one and can damage structures. When striking buildings, it will only target towers, barracks, and the Ancient.

riki.desc: Increases Cast Range to 900. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have 15% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts 1s longer and does an additional 2 attacks.

shadow_fiend.desc:
Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.

HEAL ON RETURN: 100%
COOLDOWN: 90/80/70

slark.desc:
Provides charges and increases range.

CHARGES: 2
BASE CHARGE RESTORE TIME: 12
DISTANCE: 900

spectre.desc: The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a 400 area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for 2s and have their movement speed slowed by 50%. Reduces cooldown by 20s.

templar_assassin.desc: CHANNELED - Allows Templar Assassin to teleport to any Psionic Trap after channeling for 2 seconds, detonating it upon arrival as if it was fully charged and instantly dealing 400 bonus damage. Channeling Psionic Projection does not break Meld.

When activated, traps now silence affected enemies.

MIN SILENCE DURATION: 0.25
MAX SILENCE DURATION: 3

terrorblade.desc:
Causes a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage, and grants Terrorblade Metamorphosis for a short time.

FEAR DURATION: 2
RADIUS: 1600
DAMAGE: 200
METAMORPHOSIS DURATION: 15

troll_warlord.desc:
Causes Whirling Axes (Ranged) to dispel enemies. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

MANA COST: 20
COOLDOWN: 4

Causes Whirling Axes (Melee) to dispel Troll Warlord. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

MANA COST: 25
COOLDOWN: 4

ursa.desc:
Reduces cooldown and allows Ursa to use Enrage while disabled.

COOLDOWN: 30/24/18

vengeful_spirit.desc:
Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells.

If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawns, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.

SELF MULTIPLIER: 35%
ILLUSION DAMAGE TAKEN: 100%

viper.desc: Corrosive Skin applies 4x the attack speed slow to enemies that are within 500 distance of Viper. Viper's Corrosive Skin Magic Resistance and Damage per Second are gradually increased while he is in Nethertoxin, up to 50% increased effect after 4s.

Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a 500 AoE for 4 seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.

RADIUS: 500
EFFECT DURATION: 4

weaver.desc: Time Lapse may target allied Heroes with 500 cast range.

lone_druid_bear.desc: Allows Spirit Bear to attack at any range from Lone Druid, and to survive if Lone Druid dies.

ancient_apparition.desc:
Increases Base Strength Reduction by 0.8.

STRENGTH REDUCTION: 1

chen.desc:
Decreases the cooldown of Hand of God to 110/90/70s and it becomes a channelled spell that lasts for up to 6 seconds. The initial heal happens at the start of the channel, and while channeling other nearby allied units become debuff immune with 60% magic resistance and the power of the heal over time is increased by 200%.

CHANNEL RADIUS: 800

crystal_maiden.desc: Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move 75% slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by 20%. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over 2s.

dark_seer.desc:
Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past 3 seconds. Max power is reached after 1100 distance moved.

MAX STUN DURATION: 1.25
MAX KNOCKBACK DISTANCE: 350
ILLUSION DURATION: 6
MAX DAMAGE: 400

dark_willow.desc: Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.

enchantress.desc:
Enchantress can control multiple creeps at a time.

MAX ENCHANTED CREEPS: 2

Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for 6 seconds.

RADIUS: 1200
BONUS ATTACK SPEED: 70
BONUS MOVE SPEED: 100%
MINIMUM ROOT DURATION: 2
ROOT DURATION PER UNIT: 0.5

grimstroke.desc:
Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has 90% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.

ILLUSION DURATION: 25
ILLUSION OUTGOING DAMAGE: 125%
ILLUSION DAMAGE TAKEN: 275%
ILLUSION MOVESPEED BONUS: 30%

rows.desc: Ice Wall becomes Ice Floe, Vector Targeted. After a delay, Ice Floe appears as a 150 width Ice Wall. Enemy heroes in its area for longer than 2.5 seconds become rooted and take magic damage based on Quas.

Tornado spawns twisters along its path. They persist for Tornado's duration plus additional time based on Quas, dealing damage based on Wex in a 150 radius every 0.25 seconds. (half damage to creeps.)
Creates a Cataclysm when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a 90 second cooldown. Creates 2 visible 75% damage Sun Strikes within 90-180 range of each enemy hero.

jakiro.desc:
Increases Macropyre duration and causes it to deal Pure damage. Jakiro emits two walls of ice along the edges of the Macropyre that slow any enemies trying to cross them by 60%.

DURATION: 15

keeper_of_the_light.desc:
Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.

RADIUS: 725
HIT COUNT: 7
DAMAGE: 85

leshrac.desc:
Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.

DURATION: 4
INCREASED MAGIC DAMAGE: 30%
SLOW: 40%
RADIUS: 500

lich.desc: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of 400 in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.

lina.desc:
Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.

DURATION: 7
MAGIC RESISTANCE: 35%
SPELL AMP: 35%

lion.desc:
Finger of Death gains area of effect damage on the initial cast, and increases duration and cleave damage on its subsequent melee attacks.

DAMAGE: 700/825/950
MELEE DURATION: 30
CLEAVE DAMAGE: 50%
AREA OF EFFECT: 325

necrophos.desc: Heartstopper Aura's Health Decay is increased by 50% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.

oracle.desc:
Oracle pulls a random Tarot Card now and every 90 seconds to receive its buff for 90 seconds. Oracle always knows the next Tarot Card.

Death: 40% Spell Amplification
The Fool: 100% Increased Gold Gain
The World: 150% Increased Intelligence
The Lovers: 40% Heal Amplification
The Tower: 400 All Damage Barrier (regenerates after not taking damage for 7s)

outworld_destroyer.desc:
Increases max mana to barrier. Damage that would bring Outworld Destroyer below 20% health is prevented. When that happens, Outworld Destroyer receives a strong dispel and gains an undispellable instance of Objurgation. This effect cannot occur more than once every 80 seconds.

MAX MANA BARRIER: 16%

puck.desc: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to 90% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.

pugna.desc: Reduces cooldown by 3.5s. When targeting an enemy hero, Pugna reduces their outgoing spell damage by 8% per second up to a maximum of 75% and increases his own, up to a maximum of 100%. When draining through a Nether Ward using Shard, the rate of increase/decrease is 4% instead. Debuff lasts 8 seconds.

queen_of_pain.desc: Causes Shadow Strike to become a 300 AoE Spell. When Shadow Strike ends or is re-applied to an enemy Hero, the target emits a Scream of Pain, hitting any nearby enemies.

ringmaster.desc:
Escape Act has 2 charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.

EXPLOSION RADIUS: 225
EXPLOSION DAMAGE: 300

rubick.desc:
Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.

CAST RANGE: 1400

shadow_demon.desc:
Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain 2 charges.

BASE CHARGE RESTORE TIME: 70/65/60

shadow_shaman.desc:
Increase cast range. Every 0.9 seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within 600 of the target for 100% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within 2000 units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.

CAST RANGE: 600

silencer.desc: Global Silence applies Arcane Curse to heroes for the duration of Global Silence.

skywrath_mage.desc: When Skywrath Mage casts Concussive Shot, a different random target within 500 range of the original target will be hit with the same ability. Heroes will take priority.
Anytime Skywrath Mage casts Ancient Seal, a different random target within 500 range of the original target will be affected by the same ability. Heroes will take priority.
When Skywrath Mage casts Mystic Flare, another Mystic Flare will be created on the position of a different random target enemy within 500 range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

storm_spirit.desc:
Electric Vortex affects all enemies within a radius around Storm Spirit.

RADIUS: 475

tinker.desc: Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by 13% (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.

March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.

HEAL PER SECOND: 35
HEAL DURATION: 4

Turrets fire missiles 20% faster.

ATTACK INTERVAL: 1.2

winter_wyvern.desc:
Causes Arctic Burn to be a toggle ability, draining mana every second when active. Increases Winter Wyvern's movement speed.

MANA PER SECOND: 20
MOVEMENT SPEED: 25%

witch_doctor.desc:
Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.

BOUNCE RADIUS: 575

zeus.desc:
Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.

DURATION: 30
LIGHTNING BOLT BASE COOLDOWN: 2.5
RADIUS: 450
HITS TO DESTROY: 8
CREEP HITS TO DESTROY: 16

abaddon.desc:
Increases duration. While Borrowed Time is active, anytime an ally takes more than 550 damage while within Mist Coil's cast range of Abaddon, an individual Mist Coil will automatically fire towards that ally.

DURATION: 7/8/9
DAMAGE THRESHOLD: 550

arc_warden.desc:
Flux silences when the target is alone, deals more damage, and lasts longer.

DURATION: 8
DAMAGE PER SECOND: 22.5/45/67.5/90

bane.desc: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by 40. Fiend's Grip now creates two uncontrollable illusions that are also channeling Fiend's Grip on the target. Illusions take 225% incoming damage and immediately die if they are interrupted. Damage does not stack.

batrider.desc: Flaming Lasso grabs both its target, as well as the target's nearest allied hero within 650 units. The secondary target is tethered to the first.

beastmaster.desc:
Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him to bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of 0.5s between hits after 20 attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase. Using Primal Roar counts as 10 attacks.

DAMAGE RADIUS: 525
ATTACKS FOR SHORTEST INTERVAL: 20
SHORTEST DRUM INTERVAL: 0.5
LONGEST DRUM INTERVAL: 3
DRUM HIT DAMAGE: 70
HEAL FROM HEROES: 20%
HEAL FROM CREEPS: 5%

brewmaster.desc: Primal Split gains 1 max and current level, improving the Brewlings and their abilities. Allows Primal Split to be cancelled early, and causes the Brewlings to be Brewed Up when Primal Split begins.

dazzle.desc: Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to 100% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.

death_prophet.desc:

When active, Unholy Strength grants +35 damage, +25 strength and +4 armor, but drains 45 health per second.

You cannot die from the health drain when Unholy Strength is activated, nor from the strength loss when Unholy Strength is deactivated.

active.label: Active: Dominate
active.desc:
Takes control of one neutral target unit and sets its movement speed to 380 and max health to a minimum of 1900. Also provides the unit with +70 base attack damage, +12 health regen, +4 mana regen, +7 armor, and levels up some abilities of the target by 1 level.

Dominated units with a max health of greater than 1900 retain their original max health. Grants the caster the gold and experience bounty of the dominated creep. Dominated unit's bounty is set to 250 gold and it can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise.

The Helm cannot be used for 3 seconds after the dominated creep takes damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

consecrated_wraps.name: Consecrated Wraps
consecrated_wraps.desc:
Passive: Hallowed
Gain a charge every 4s, up to a maximum of 3 charges. Upon gaining a charge, your movement speed is increased by 15% for 5s.

Whenever you take damage from a player-controlled source or Roshan, consume all charges to gain an all damage barrier for 5s that absorbs 120 damage per charge (360 max).

aeon_disk.name: Aeon Disk
aeon_disk.desc:
Passive: Combo Breaker
When you take damage and your health falls below 70%, a strong dispel is applied and you gain a 2.5 second buff that provides +75% Status Resistance and causes all damage you deal and are dealt to be reduced to zero. Only triggers on player based damage. Cooldown increases every time it triggers.
Dispel Type: Strong Dispel

Applies a shield to the target unit for 5 seconds which re-casts most targeted spells back to their caster.

The shielded unit will still take damage from the spell.

revenants_brooch.name: Revenant's Brooch
revenants_brooch.desc:

basher.name: Skull Basher
basher.desc:
Passive: Bash
Grants melee heroes a 25% chance on hit to stun the target for 1.2 seconds and deal 100 bonus physical damage. Bash chance for ranged heroes is 10%.

If attacking to end the invisibility, you gain 175 bonus physical damage on that attack.

rapier.desc:

Dropped on death, and cannot be destroyed.

Becomes unusable if picked up by an ally of its owner until it is returned to its owner. It is immediately usable by anybody if an enemy of the owner picks it up and is killed. A dropped Rapier cannot be picked up by a courier.

Passive: Witch Blade
Causes your next attack to apply a poison for 4 seconds, slowing by 25% and dealing 0.75x your intelligence as damage every second. This attack has True Strike.

specialists_array.desc:
Passive: Splitshot
Ranged attacks have a 30% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to 2 nearby enemies with 150 extra range and within a 120 degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal 20 + 75% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects. The primary attack deals 20 + 100% damage of a normal attack.

harpoon.stats:

active.desc: When targeting an enemy, fire a harpoon at them, that pulls you and the target closer together, up to 35% of the distance between you and your target. If the caster is melee, the hero and target are always pulled to within melee distance of each other. Targeting a tree always pulls you all the way to that tree.

harpoon.desc:

active.desc:
Dispels both the wearer and the target. Enemy targets are slowed for 4 seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movespeed and 40% slow resistance for 4 seconds. Caster is always granted the ally benefit on cast.

Both movement speed reduction and increase start at 100% and gradually decrease to 0% over the course of the buff duration.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel

Ranged attacks have a 30% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to 3 nearby enemies with 150 extra range and within a 120 degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal 20 + 75% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects except for Miasma. The primary attack deals 20 + 100% damage of a normal attack.

active.label: Active: Overwhelming Blink
active.desc:
Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away.

After teleportation, all enemies in a 800 AoE take damage equal to 100 + 50% of your strength and an additional 100% over time, and have 50% movement speed slow and 50 attack speed slow for 6 seconds.

Overwhelming Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

active.label: Active: Swift Blink
active.desc:
Teleport to a target point up to 1200 units away.

After teleportation, you gain 40% phased movement speed and +35 Agility for 6 seconds.

Swift Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

active.label: Active: Arcane Blink
active.desc:
Teleport to a target point up to 1400 units away.

After teleportation, you restore 250 health and 100 mana.

Arcane Blink cannot be used for 3 seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

skadi.name: Eye of Skadi
skadi.desc:
Passive: Cold Attack
Attacks lower enemy movement by -25% if they are melee and -50% if they are ranged. Attacks also lower enemy attack speed by -25% and Health Restoration by 50%. Lasts for 3 seconds.

active.label: Upgrade: Town Portal Scroll
active.desc: Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units and heroes, reduces cooldown, channel time and does not consume a charge on usage.
